nodes.description: mapping(address => uint256) private _balances; stores token balances and is written in the constructor and mutated inside _transfer.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) private _allowances; the approval table written only by the private _approve helper.
uint256 private _tTotal = 70 * 10**9 * 10**18; the fixed total supply returned by totalSupply().
address private _owner declared in Ownable; set in the constructor and mutated by renounceOwnership()/transferOwnership().
address private newComer = _msgSender(); initialised at declaration time (deployment) and used as the authority reference in the onlyOwner modifier.
constructor() public of MewInu; mints the whole supply to _msgSender() and sets Ownable._owner.
_transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) internal; performs the balance bookkeeping with SafeMath sub/add.
_approve(address ol, address tt, uint256 amount) private; writes _allowances but silently forces the allowance to 0 whenever ol != owner().
transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) public override; delegates to _transfer with _msgSender() as sender.
transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) public override; calls _transfer then re-approves the remaining allowance through _approve.
approve(address spender, uint256 amount) public override; forwards to the private _approve helper.
allowance(address owner, address spender) public view override; reads the _allowances mapping.
balanceOf(address account) public view override; reads the _balances mapping.
totalSupply() public view override; returns the immutable _tTotal.
owner() public view; returns _owner, and is also used as the privilege comparison inside _approve.
renounceOwnership() public virtual onlyOwner; clears _owner but leaves newComer untouched, so the modifier stays bound to the original deployer.
transferOwnership(address newOwner) private onlyOwner; unreachable from outside because of the private visibility.
_msgSender() internal view virtual in Context; wraps msg.sender and is the only source of caller identity.
msg.sender obtained through _msgSender(); attacker-controllable caller identity used for balances, approvals and the ownership check.

onlyOwner modifier gate: require(newComer == _msgSender()). newComer is frozen at deployment and is never synchronised with _owner, so ownership can never be transferred (transferOwnership is private) and renouncing _owner does not remove the deployer's authority.

Hidden privilege branch in _approve: for any ol != owner() the stored allowance is overwritten with 0, so ordinary users' approvals are silently neutralised and transferFrom reverts, while the owner keeps full allowance control.
address sender parameter of _transfer; the debited account.
address recipient parameter of _transfer; the credited account.
uint256 amount parameter of _transfer; value moved between the two balances.
address ol parameter of _approve; the allowance owner key.
address tt parameter of _approve; the spender key.
uint256 amount parameter of _approve; the allowance value that is conditionally zeroed.
address sender parameter of transferFrom; the account whose allowance is consumed.
address recipient parameter of transferFrom; the credited account.
uint256 amount parameter of transferFrom; value transferred and subtracted from the allowance.
address owner parameter of allowance(); lookup key in _allowances.
address spender parameter of allowance(); second lookup key in _allowances.
address spender parameter of public approve(); forwarded to _approve as tt.
uint256 amount parameter of public approve(); forwarded to _approve.
address recipient parameter of public transfer(); forwarded into _transfer.
uint256 amount parameter of public transfer(); forwarded into _transfer.
address newOwner parameter of transferOwnership(); unreachable because the function is private.
Local expression _allowances[sender][_msgSender()].sub(amount, ...) in transferFrom; the remaining allowance passed back into _approve.

edges.reason: constructor reads msg.sender via _msgSender() to mint the entire supply and to set Ownable._owner.
public transfer() uses _msgSender() as the debited sender.
transferFrom() uses _msgSender() as the spender whose allowance is consumed.
public approve() passes _msgSender() as the allowance owner into _approve.
newComer is initialised from _msgSender() at declaration, permanently binding the onlyOwner gate to the deployer.
_msgSender() returns msg.sender, propagating the untrusted caller identity into the contract.
the isCore authority value newComer flows into the require(newComer == _msgSender()) guard.
attacker-controllable msg.sender is compared against newComer inside the onlyOwner modifier.
onlyOwner gates renounceOwnership(); after it runs _owner is zeroed while newComer still holds the deployer address.
onlyOwner gates transferOwnership(), which is private and therefore cannot be invoked externally at all.
constructor writes _balances[_msgSender()] = _tTotal.
Ownable constructor assigns _owner = _msgSender().
public transfer() delegates to the internal _transfer().
transferFrom() delegates the balance movement to _transfer().
transferFrom() calls _approve with the reduced allowance, triggering the privilege branch that zeroes non-owner allowances.
public approve() routes every user straight into the privileged _approve helper.
_transfer subtracts from _balances[sender] and adds to _balances[recipient] via SafeMath.
balanceOf() reads the _balances mapping.
_approve writes the _allowances[ol][tt] slot.
allowance() reads the _allowances mapping.
owner() returns the _owner state variable.
_approve compares ol against owner() to decide whether to store or zero the allowance.
renounceOwnership() sets _owner = address(0).
transferOwnership() would assign the new owner to _owner.
totalSupply() returns the constant _tTotal.
the if (ol != owner()) branch is the unsafe operation that silently resets a user's allowance to zero.
sender parameter is the account debited inside _transfer.
recipient parameter is the account credited inside _transfer.
amount parameter is the value subtracted and added in _transfer.
ol parameter selects the allowance owner slot in _approve.
tt parameter selects the spender slot in _approve.
amount parameter is the value written into _allowances, or discarded in favour of 0.
sender parameter of transferFrom flows into _transfer and into the allowance computation.
recipient parameter of transferFrom flows into _transfer.
amount parameter of transferFrom is transferred and also subtracted from the allowance.
owner parameter indexes the first level of _allowances in allowance().
spender parameter indexes the second level of _allowances in allowance().
spender parameter is forwarded from approve() into _approve.
amount parameter is forwarded from approve() into _approve.
recipient parameter is forwarded from transfer() into _transfer.
amount parameter is forwarded from transfer() into _transfer.
newOwner parameter would become the new _owner, but the private function is unreachable.
the computed remaining allowance is reused as the amount argument of _approve inside transferFrom.
transferFrom computes the remaining allowance from _allowances[sender][_msgSender()].sub(amount).

recipient is a plain input of the internal _transfer.
amount is a plain input of the internal _transfer.
ol is only used inside the private _approve helper.
tt is only used inside the private _approve helper.
amount is only used inside the private _approve helper.
sender is the allowance-owner argument of the transferFrom entry point.
recipient is forwarded from transferFrom into _transfer.
amount is forwarded from transferFrom into _transfer and the allowance subtraction.
owner is only a lookup key in the allowance() view function.
spender is only a lookup key in the allowance() view function.
spender is an argument of the public approve() entry point.
amount is an argument of the public approve() entry point.
recipient is an argument of the public transfer() entry point.
amount is an argument of the public transfer() entry point.
newOwner is only referenced by the private transferOwnership() function.
the remaining-allowance computation is an intermediate expression local to transferFrom.
